+import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+import { resolveAiosRoot } from "@/server/aios/filesystem";
+
+export type WorkflowSkillCandidateAction = "promote" | "dismiss";
+
+export type WorkflowSkillCandidateUpdateInput = {
+  id: string;
+  action: WorkflowSkillCandidateAction;
+};
+
+export type PromotedWorkflowSkillResult = {
+  ok: boolean;
+  skillKey: string;
+};
+
+export type DismissedWorkflowSkillResult = {
+  ok: boolean;
+};
+
+type PythonWorkflowSkillResult = {
+  ok: boolean;
+  skill_key?: string;
+};
+
+type PythonEnvelope = {
+  data?: PythonWorkflowSkillResult;
+  error?: { message?: string };
+};
+
+const resolveDbPath = (): string => {
+  const configuredPath = process.env.AIOS_DB?.trim();
+  if (!configuredPath) {
+    return path.join(os.homedir(), "AIOS", "data", "aios.db");
+  }
+  if (configuredPath === "~") {
+    return os.homedir();
+  }
+  if (configuredPath.startsWith("~/")) {
+    return path.join(os.homedir(), configuredPath.slice(2));
+  }
+  return path.resolve(configuredPath);
+};
+
+export function updateWorkflowSkillCandidateViaPythonOwner(
+  input: WorkflowSkillCandidateUpdateInput & { action: "promote" },
+): PromotedWorkflowSkillResult;
+export function updateWorkflowSkillCandidateViaPythonOwner(
+  input: WorkflowSkillCandidateUpdateInput & { action: "dismiss" },
+): DismissedWorkflowSkillResult;
+export function updateWorkflowSkillCandidateViaPythonOwner(
+  input: WorkflowSkillCandidateUpdateInput,
+): PromotedWorkflowSkillResult | DismissedWorkflowSkillResult {
+  const root = resolveAiosRoot();
+  const script = path.join(root, "bin", "aios.py");
+  try {
+    const output = execFileSync(
+      "python3",
+      [
+        script,
+        "--json",
+        "--db",
+        resolveDbPath(),
+        "workflow-skill-candidate-update",
+        "--payload-json",
+        JSON.stringify(input),
+      ],
+      {
+        cwd: root,
+        encoding: "utf8",
+        maxBuffer: 256 * 1024,
+      },
+    );
+    const envelope = JSON.parse(output) as PythonEnvelope;
+    if (!envelope.data) {
+      throw new Error(envelope.error?.message ?? "Python owner returned no workflow skill payload.");
+    }
+    if (input.action === "promote") {
+      return { ok: envelope.data.ok, skillKey: envelope.data.skill_key ?? "" };
+    }
+    return { ok: envelope.data.ok };
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof Error && error.message.startsWith("Python owner returned")) {
+      throw error;
+    }
+    throw new Error("Python workflow skill owner rejected the mutation.", { cause: error });
